summary: Iteration 11: Tested new features - AI Weekly Summary section with Generate button, Notifications settings with 3 toggles (Dose, Journal, Weekly), Browse by Goal filtering in Research tab, and enhanced full-text search. All features render correctly and function as expected.

Browse by Goal uses proper GOAL_CATEGORIES constant from peptides.ts
Full-text search implementation in research.tsx correctly searches across name, aliases, description, mechanism, and categories
